scripts.dev: npm run build -w @jeddah/shared && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @jeddah/api" "npm run dev -w @jeddah/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jeddah/shared && npm run build -w @jeddah/api && npm run build -w @jeddah/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @jeddah/shared && npm run typecheck -w @jeddah/api && npm run typecheck -w @jeddah/web
